name: Mutur–Verugal

details: Red road segments appear beside the inland lagoons south of Koddiyar Bay, as far as the Verugal crossing area. Individual links across water are unresolved at this scale.

locator: Upper east coast from Verugal crossing area to northern Batticaloa lagoon
details: Red road segments appear along the coastal corridor south of Verugal toward Valaichchenai. Individual links across water are unresolved at this scale.

name: Lady Manning Bridge and approaches, Kallady
details: Governor opened the bridge and road approaches. Six 150-foot spans. Rail provision was conditional on any southern extension from Batticaloa.
